recognize_zh: 高倍下兩顆分葉核嗜中性球，細胞核分成 3 葉、以細絲相連，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡粉紅並佈滿均勻細小的淡紫色特殊顆粒，沒有空泡或杜勒小體，是正常成熟嗜中性球。
features: Two cells about 1.5–2 times the diameter of an RBC
Nuclei segmented into 3 lobes joined by thin chromatin strands
Abundant pale pink cytoplasm with fine, evenly dispersed lilac-pink specific granules
No toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuoles
Adjacent platelets and normal red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows two mature segmented neutrophils. Each nucleus has three lobes joined by thin filaments with coarse condensed chromatin and no nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale with fine, evenly distributed specific granules, without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuolization. Adjacent platelets and red cells are unremarkable. Findings represent normal mature neutrophil morphology.

ddx.vs: A band has a continuous U- or S-shaped nucleus without filamentous constrictions between lobes.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes, as in megaloblastic anemia, compared with three here.
Toxic granulation shows coarse dark blue-black granules, often with Döhle bodies and vacuoles, unlike these fine lilac granules.
